name: 21_place_cup_on_plate
title: Sorting Teaware and Covering Plate
summary: A robotic arm arranges tea cups onto plates, covers a plate with a book, and later uncovers it.
robot: one white arm with a parallel gripper
setting: a white desk with tea cups, plates, a vintage radio, and a potted plant

source.original_prompt: pick up the green cup and place it on the green plate

segments.instruction: The robot arm reaches down and grasps the small green cup. The camera remains fixed.
The robot carries the green cup and places it centered on the green plate.
The robot moves to the bottom right and grasps the closed book.
The robot lifts the book and places it squarely over the yellow plate.
segments.memory_event: hide: the yellow plate is completely covered by the book

segments.instruction: The robot reaches toward the yellow cup and grasps its handle.
The robot lifts the yellow cup and places it in front of the vintage radio.
The robot grasps the book and lifts it off the plate.
segments.memory_event: return: the yellow plate is uncovered, remaining in its original position

segments.instruction: The robot moves the book back to the bottom right corner of the table and releases it.
